column1: # One row per TLC config: cfg path, module, safety rules expected to break, optional liveness properties expected to break.
# Fields are tab-separated; rule lists are comma-separated; "-" or an omitted fourth field means none break.
# Safety rules are invariant names, plus NoDeadlock for a deadlock. Liveness names come from PROPERTY/PROPERTIES.
# scripts/ci/statecharts_tlc.py fails when a run breaks a rule not listed here or a listed rule holds.
# BeforeGateway safety holds but temporary PROPERTY AdmissionResumes fails (13); fix3 passes (0).
# WriterAdoption (TUI Legacy body, stage 1): Main and GateOnly document the gaps; Stage1 passes; the rest drop one stage-1 guard.
